messages:
Maria P: FYI customer reported export problems in Console audit viewer: duplicate rows on large time ranges, missing KMS identifiers in CSV/JSON, and 403s for users with `audit_viewer` when they try to export. Can we triage?
Alex K: I can repro dupes locally. Steps: query with cursor pagination + concat pages -> duplicates of same event_id but different sequence. quick repro: 
```
GET /api/audit?start=1680000000&end=1680050000&page_size=1000
follow cursor tokens, concat results
```
Result: event_id E123 repeated. Looks like exporter appends pages without dedupe.
Josh R: That matches shadowing during shard rebalances. Runtime emits per-shard sequence; dedupe should canonicalize by event_id. Will add server-side dedupe pass in exporter. Also propose adding `schema_version` to header so downstream tools can adapt.
Ian S: Export job also hits timeouts for >50k rows. Current S3 approach opens a new connection per chunk causing thrash. Suggest streaming JSONL + gzip with keep-alive or presigned multipart upload. Also we should increase page_size to 5k with backoff. I'll bench a 200k event export.
Olivia T: Product note: any schema change needs backwards compatibility. Add `schema_version` as optional string (e.g., "v2") and only emit new fields when present. We should add a Console tooltip and document in changelog. Also we need customer-facing note about masked KMS identifiers.
sec-bot: Security scan: do NOT put secret material in exports. It's OK to include KMS key identifiers, but mask ARNs for non-admins (show last 8 chars). Current missing key info likely due to redaction logic. Filing SEC-3241 to track masking approval.
Alex K: Found bug: exporter filters fields with `if user.role != 'admin': redact(kms_key)`. When export is kicked off by a service account we lose original caller context so everything gets redacted. Fix: thread `export_initiator` through the pipeline or attach original_requester metadata to export job. I'll add an integration test for context propagation.
Maria P: Good catch. For dedupe, let's dedupe by `event_id` at export time and add schema_version to exported header. For KMS: mask ARNs for non-admins, keep key_id (masked). For 403s: check RBAC mapping for `audit_viewer` on export action - maybe export permission split off into `audit_export` in RBAC matrix.
Josh R: Plan: small patch to exporter for dedupe + header `schema_version: v2` (keep legacy when absent). PR by EOD Thu.
Alex K: I'll change streamer to receive `export_initiator` and restore caller context for redaction logic. PR by Mon.
Ian S: POC of JSONL+gzip streaming and S3 multipart presigned -> will share perf numbers next Wed. If infra required for multipart presigned, loop in infra.
Olivia T: I'll draft UX tooltip and customer comms clarifying masking and schema_version, plus how to request audited exports for full ARNs. Draft by Tue.
sec-bot: SEC-3241 updated with masking rules and approval steps. Security to review exported field allowlist by Fri.
Maria P: Action items recap: Josh - dedupe & schema_version; Alex - role-context propagation; Ian - streaming prototype; Olivia - comms + tooltip; sec-bot/Maria - masking review. Ping /oncall if blocked. :thumbsup:
